rules.rule: Server controllers/routes must not instantiate AWS, database, or external provider clients directly. Use modules under server/src/services/ or server/src/config/.
Validate HTTP params, query, body, files, and auth context before service/domain logic uses them.
Database access must use parameterized queries. Never interpolate user input into SQL strings.
Anti-fraud and trust-score behavior must use explicit, testable thresholds/policies and must not be hidden in UI-only state.
Environment variables and provider configuration should be parsed in config modules. Domain logic should receive typed/configured values rather than reading process.env directly.
